runtimeArgs: cd server && GOOGLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=0 DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 npm start

configurations._comment: api-scratch with a stub mailer that prints each email instead of sending it (server/scripts/dev-stub-mail.js), for the send panel and queue. STUB_MAIL_FAIL=1 makes every send fail.
configurations.name: api-scratch-mail
runtimeArgs: cd server && GOOGLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=0 DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5173/ node scripts/dev-stub-mail.js

configurations._comment: api-scratch with a pretend Hnry (server/scripts/dev-stub-hnry.js): invoices are "made in Hnry" by the test fake, with a control server on :8081 (POST /fail, POST /reset, GET /drafts) to put Hnry in the state to look at. Use a fresh data dir, not the real-Google scratch DB: DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-hnry, seeded with ADMIN_USERNAME=dev ADMIN_PASSWORD=scratch-dev-password npm run seed.
configurations.name: api-scratch-hnry
runtimeArgs: cd server && GOOGLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=0 DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-hnry CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5173/ SESSION_SECRET=dev-session-secret-0123456789-0123456789 node scripts/dev-stub-hnry.js

configurations._comment: The REAL Hnry, through Zapier (hnry-invoicing H8/H9): the api-scratch-hnry database with the Zapier SDK credential from the 1Password Environment ZAPIER_CREDENTIALS, mounted at ~/.config/lsc-billing/hnry.env, outside the Drive folder because the preview launcher can't read a 1Password pipe inside it and read through grep, the one reader 1Password serves it to here (sh and awk get nothing) (create it with the 1Password MCP create_local_env_file; never copy values into a file). Accepting a project or pressing Create/Retry here makes REAL drafts in Hnry: only with the user's own client record (H9). Settings -> Hnry's check only signs in.
configurations.name: api-scratch-hnry-live
runtimeArgs: eval "$(grep -E '^ZAPIER_CREDENTIALS_CLIENT_(ID|SECRET)=' "$HOME/.config/lsc-billing/hnry.env" | sed 's/^/export /')" && cd server && GOOGLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=0 DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-hnry CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5173/ SESSION_SECRET=dev-session-secret-0123456789-0123456789 node scripts/dev-stub-mail.js

configurations._comment: api-scratch with a pretend Google (server/scripts/dev-stub-google.js): Connect goes to a local consent page and every Google call is answered locally, for Settings → Google Calendar without an OAuth client. STUB_GOOGLE_REFRESH_FAIL=1 makes Google refuse the refresh token; STUB_GOOGLE_DOWN=1 makes it unreachable.
configurations.name: api-scratch-google
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5173/ node scripts/dev-stub-google.js

configurations._comment: Writing bookings (trip-planner task 14) against a COPY of the scratch database with its Google account removed, and a pretend Google that keeps the events it is sent (GET :8080/dev/google-events lists them). Never point a write-capable build at /tmp/lsc-billing-scratch: its google_account row is the user's real calendar. Make the copy: server/ `node -e` backup of that file into /tmp/lsc-billing-scratch-sync, then DELETE FROM google_account and google_event_sync. STUB_GOOGLE_WRITE_FAIL=1 makes every write fail.
configurations.name: api-scratch-sync
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch-sync CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5173/ node scripts/dev-stub-google.js

configurations._comment: Writing bookings to the user's REAL Google calendar (trip-planner task 14 live check): the scratch database that holds the real connection, stub mailer, and NO GOOGLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=0. Only touch a test project here; never Sync existing bookings. Back the DB up first and delete the test project after.
configurations.name: api-scratch-live
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5173/ node scripts/dev-stub-mail.js

configurations._comment: A never-configured database, for verifying the first-run setup steps on the estimates empty state — those only render while the pricing and settings rows have never been written, which api-scratch's database has. Delete /tmp/lsc-billing-firstrun to reset it. Seed it first: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-firstrun ADMIN_USERNAME=dev ADMIN_PASSWORD=<12+ chars> npm run seed
configurations.name: api-firstrun
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-firstrun CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 npm start

configurations.name: design

configurations._comment: The ui-clarity worktree's own API (ROADMAP §2): its own copy of the scratch data with no Google account, stub mailer, port 8081 so it never collides with this folder's :8080. Make the copy with a better-sqlite3 backup of /tmp/lsc-billing-scratch-sync into /tmp/lsc-billing-scratch-uic, then DELETE FROM google_event_sync and google_account. The worktree's gitignored web/js/config.js points at :8081.
configurations.name: api-uic
runtimeArgs: cd server && GOOGLE_CALENDAR_WRITE=0 DATA_DIR=/tmp/lsc-billing-scratch-uic PORT=8081 CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5174 COOKIE_SAMESITE=none COOKIE_SECURE=1 APP_URL=http://localhost:5174/ node scripts/dev-stub-mail.js
